## Source: amazon-inspector (4c846898be0d2a1d2117385e5a45262bb719ee6aab9dc85dfe75b503f074540a)
Analysis of acousticpack 0.1.0 (pypi) across 10 files produced no indicators of credential access, outbound exfiltration, install-time or import-time code execution from remote sources, silent relay, backdoor channels, or filesystem destruction. No lifecycle or build-backend network activity was identified, and no suspicious code patterns were observed in the package contents.

## Source: kam193 (e9796cf3d8fa108f7e354640578e92abd850a9b899dbc8e0e22f14e40bcd4a02)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
